title: On the Gradient Domination of the LQG Problem
abstract: arXiv:2507.09026v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider solutions to the linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) regulator problem via policy gradient (PG) methods. Although PG methods have demonstrated strong theoretical guarantees in solving the linear quadratic regulator (LQR) problem, despite its nonconvex landscape, their theoretical understanding in the LQG setting remains limited. Notably, the LQG problem lacks gradient dominance in the classical parameterization, i.e., with a dynamic controller, which hinders global convergence guarantees. In this work, we study a PG method for the LQG problem by adopting an alternative parameterization of the set of stabilizing controllers and employing a lifting argument. We refer to this parameterization as a history representation of the control input as it is parameterized by past input and output data from the previous p time-steps. translated_title: 关于LQG问题的梯度支配性研究
translated_abstract: 我们通过策略梯度（PG）方法研究线性二次高斯（LQG）调节器问题的求解。尽管PG方法在求解线性二次调节器（LQR）问题方面已经展现出强大的理论保证（尽管其优化景观是非凸的），但人们对其在LQG设定下的理论理解仍然有限。值得注意的是，LQG问题在经典参数化（即采用动态控制器）下缺乏梯度支配性，这阻碍了全局收敛保证的建立。在本工作中，我们通过采用一种对镇定控制器集合的替代参数化并运用提升论证，研究了LQG问题的PG方法。我们将这种参数化称为控制输入的历史表示，因为它由之前p个时间步的输入和输出数据进行参数化。在该参数化下，无限历史的LQG优化问题可简化为一个等价的静态（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于过去p个时间步输入输出数据的控制输入历史表示参数化方法，将LQG问题转化为具有梯度支配性的等价静态优化问题，从而为策略梯度方法求解LQG问题建立了全局收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a history representation parameterization based on past input-output data, which reduces the LQG problem to an equivalent static optimization with gradient domination, enabling global convergence guarantees for policy gradient methods.
